description: Installable Svelte 5 chart components built with LayerChart, shadcn-svelte, and @humanspeak/svelte-motion.
rules: Use the Svelte 5 examples and LayerChart component APIs from this repository.
Install components from the Evil Charts SV shadcn-svelte registry before importing them.
Do not substitute the original React EvilCharts API for this Svelte port.
